correctness.rationale: Independently regenerated all 24 seven-edge perfect matchings, 2,201 nonempty perfect-complex faces and 3,461 ordinary-complex faces with complete f vectors matching the source. The source 1,092-pair Hasse-graph acyclic matching yields one vertex plus sixteen 2-cells and H2=Q^16. Ordinary mod-2 boundary ranks (20,148,496,722,312,24) with rank-of-chain upper bounds yield rational H4=Q^16. I independently regenerated all 336 automorphisms in the Fano model and evaluated both signed simplex traces under each: preserving/swap classes match all eight character rows (preserve orders 1,2,3,4,7: traces 16,0,1,0,2; swap orders 2,6,8: perfect -4,-1,0 vs ordinary +4,+1,0). The character equality elementwise and semisimplicity over Q prove module isomorphism. Averaging gives fixed dimensions 0 for G and 1 for B. Finite enumeration is exhaustive for exactly H, not an incidence-graph-family proof; quotient statement is rational homology, not contractibility or integral representation equivalence.
